plan.title: Payments service cutover
plan.summary: Rehearse moving traffic to a new release, with an explicit go/no-go checkpoint and a verified recovery path.

steps.title: Confirm the release baseline
steps.instructions: Confirm the approved build, contact roster and maintenance window. Keep the current deployment reference available.
steps.verification: Record the build reference and the named decision owner.
steps.rollback: Stop the change before modifying traffic.

steps.title: Verify the recovery point
steps.instructions: Check the last verified backup and rehearse the restore procedure in an isolated environment.
steps.verification: Record the backup reference and observed restore-test result.
steps.rollback: Use the reviewed recovery procedure; assess any data written after the recovery point.

steps.title: Deploy the canary
steps.instructions: Deploy the candidate to the rehearsal environment and route a small test cohort.
steps.verification: Record the candidate version and test cohort result.
steps.rollback: Remove the candidate from routing and retain the previous version.

steps.title: Run the acceptance checks
steps.instructions: Exercise authentication, payment creation and refund flows using test data.
steps.verification: Record the acceptance-test result and any failed checks.
steps.rollback: Stop progression and investigate the candidate.

steps.title: Review the go/no-go decision
steps.instructions: Review recovery evidence and acceptance results with the decision owner.
steps.verification: Record the decision and the evidence used. This is a rehearsal note, not a verified approval.
steps.rollback: Keep current routing and communicate the hold.

steps.title: Switch the traffic cohort
steps.instructions: Walk through the routing change, monitoring points and stop conditions. Do not execute live commands here.
steps.verification: Record the planned routing state and monitoring thresholds.
steps.rollback: Revert routing only after reviewing data consistency and the current system state.

steps.title: Observe the service window
steps.instructions: Compare error rate and latency against the agreed baseline.
steps.verification: Record the observed test metrics and the decision to continue or stop.
steps.rollback: Use the reviewed rollback instructions if the stop condition is met.

steps.title: Complete the operational handoff
steps.instructions: Share the rehearsal report, open issues and next owner.
steps.verification: Record the report location and the receiving owner.
steps.rollback: Keep the change open until ownership and follow-up work are assigned.
